79463.subject: Revolut confirms dual IPO on Nasdaq and LSE, and it’s London’s best available deal 🇺🇸🇬🇧; Meta Muse Connectors …
79463.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1128

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Monday! Today, we’re breaking down Revolut's confirmed dual IPO on Nasdaq and the LSE to see why this is London's best available deal, not a vote of confidence in the London Stock Exchange (why Storonsky spent 3 years calling London irrational and what specifically changed his math, how Wise's LSE-to-Nasdaq migration is the closest precedent for what comes next + bonus dives into Revolut’s recent data breach, and why it’s interesting [ https://substack.com/redirect/7c65e65c-8f2c-485e-9989-f239d4fe7575?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & deep dive into Why We Aren’t Bullish Enough on Revolut [ https://substack.com/redirect/927f8974-355f-4e1a-9402-cb375e007feb?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving into Meta's Muse [ https://substack.com/redirect/7cecdce8-b27b-4b44-8c31-091f2b7b9959?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] connector launch, which is essentially Meta's bid to become the App Store for Agentic Commerce (why connectors plus the Stilla acquisition [ https://substack.com/redirect/f3eb0537-db7d-4fe2-991e-93155de72224?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] give Meta agents on both sides of every transaction, why the gap between Meta's ambition and its actual developer platform is the most important fact in this story, & what every consumer-facing business needs to do now + bonus deep dives into the Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/ffee323f-f546-463b-96ee-70cd03aadd33?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and Anthropic’s Strategy to Win Agentic Commerce [ https://substack.com/redirect/af990d62-29c9-48e2-bce0-2c38bf818a62?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Revolut confirms dual IPO on Nasdaq and LSE, and it’s London’s best available deal 🇺🇸🇬🇧
The news 🗞️ Co-founder & CEO Nik Storonsky confirmed last week that Revolut will pursue a dual IPO on Nasdaq and the London Stock Exchange, with the company now being valued at $115 billion privately and internal targets of $150B to $200B at listing.
But his own words about each market make the hierarchy clear. Nasdaq, not London, will determine Revolut’s valuation.
Let’s unpack this...

Po kríze pribudli záložné trasy a solárne panely, nie však odolnejšia energetika ani zdravšie verejné financie. Keď ropa, plyn a elektrina opäť zdraželi, krajina vstúpila do ďalšieho otrasu s rovnakými slabinami...pokračovanie Eurozónu čakajú tri vlny inflácie. Prvá príde tento rok Najprudší cenový skok udrie ešte tento rok, návrat k pokoju však nebude priamočiary. Každá ďalšia vlna zasiahne inú časť rodinného rozpočtu Fiškálna pasca sa zatvára. Nový rozpočet už nemá dobrý ťah Tri konsolidačné balíky pokoj nepriniesli. Vláda teraz skladá rozpočet, v ktorom môže ekonomike uškodiť ďalší dlh, nové dane aj nesprávne škrty Bratislavská dilema. Prečo pracovať v Rakúsku a bývať na Slovensku Vyšší rakúsky plat ešte neznamená, že sa oplatí presunúť za hranice aj celý život. Rozhodujú bývanie, rodina, čas strávený cestovaním aj istota pracovného miesta Slovensko láme rekordy, automobilová kostra mu však redne Nový závod pri Košiciach môže posunúť výrobu áut ešte vyššie. Skutočný ekonomický súboj sa ale odohrá mimo montážnej linky – o diely, technológie a hodnotu, ktoré zostanú doma Omnia KLF stavia záchranu fabriky na výrobe pre segment obranného priemyslu Takmer osemdesiatročná kysucká fabrika bojuje o prežitie. Rudolf Sihlovec vysvetľuje, ako ju chcú dostať z dlhov a čo rozhodne o jej budúcnosti Dividendový fond poráža S&P 500. Dlhodobý výsledok už tak nepoteší Slovenskému investorovi môže pravidelná dividenda priniesť vyšší daňový účet než postupný predaj portfólia Čo proti rakovine ponúka trh? Rozdiely medzi poisťovňami sú tisíce eur Ani v najbohatších krajinách sveta na rakovinu často nestačí klasické zdravotné poistenie. Na túto finančnú medzeru má odpoveď aj slovenský komerčný trh

79435.subject: Weekly Recap: Congress Said No, The Agencies Said Yes
79435.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

The **Senate** rejected cloture on the **CLARITY Act** 49-50 on Tuesday, 11 votes short of 60. Every yes came from a Republican. **Thom Tillis** voted no in order to file a motion to reconsider, and entered it a minute after the result.

The **FOMC** raised its target range a quarter point to 3.75%-4% on Wednesday, its first increase since July 2023. Bitcoin touched $76,500 in the five minutes after the statement and gave it all back within half an hour. The 10-year closed at 5.01%, its highest since July 2007. **Zcash** ran to $1,383.

**Paul Atkins** and **Michael Selig** said on Wednesday they would write crypto rules without the bill. On Thursday the **SEC** issued a five-year exemption letting tokenized NMS stock trade onchain through permissioned pools, capped at 75 Tier 1 symbols, with issuers holding a 30-day veto over third-party listings. **CFTC** staff opened introducing-broker relief to any passive software provider the same morning, and the agency sent a market structure rulemaking to the White House at the prerule stage.

**Circle** opened Arc's mainnet with **BlackRock**, **DTCC**, **Visa** and eight other institutions producing blocks. **Coinbase** filed for U.S. single-stock perpetual futures. **X** put a Trade button on cashtags routing to Coinbase, **Kraken** and **Gemini**. **S&P Global** agreed to buy **OpenZeppelin**.

Bitcoin finished the week at $81,000, up 5.8% on Friday alone. **NEAR** added 32%, **Starknet** 27%, **Arbitrum** 26% and **Uniswap** 20%. Of the 125 largest non-stablecoin tokens, 111 rose.

Enjoy!

———————————————————————————

# Top Stories This Week

## The Senate Blocked The CLARITY Act 49-50

Cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R. 3633 failed 49-50 on Tuesday, [11 votes short of the 60 required](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/senate-blocks-clarity-act-49-50-with-no-democratic-votes-to-proceed), with Susan Collins, Josh Hawley, Jerry Moran and Thom Tillis the four Republicans voting no and no Democrat or independent voting to proceed. Republicans had [posted final text a day earlier](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/republicans-post-final-clarity-act-text-with-trump-backed-ethics-terms) with an ethics division they said reflected substantially all of the Tillis-Gallego proposal. Mark Warner, one of seven Democrats who negotiated the bill for a year, said the president's ability to profit from crypto made it impossible for him to vote yes. Trade groups and executives [answered by pointing at agency rulemaking](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/crypto-industry-points-to-sec-and-cftc-after-clarity-setback), and kept returning to durability: a future chair can rewrite a rule, while repealing a statute takes another act of Congress. Tillis entered his motion to reconsider a minute after the result, which keeps a second cloture vote available without a new filing.
